interpretation: Native campaign completion flags describe the construction test suite, not the separate 89-case frozen-kernel panel.
Configured duration, final-model reservation, drain and observed wall time are separate fields. Do not infer author time from a single duration field.
reference_analysis can use a precomputed expert corpus even when live_cca is false.

recorded_completion.performance_qualification: reported separately by versioned timing evidence

operator_measurement_policy.configuration_rule: Derive model structure from pinned RTL facts and selected configuration. Calibrate uncertain timing parameters against matched cycle-accurate gSIM observations; do not fit around configuration contradictions.
operator_measurement_policy.fit_rule: Diagnostics do not qualify a fit. Use the existing calibration planner for identifiability and independent point requirements; hold validation source groups out of fitting. Missing source groups remain unknown. Use at least the independent points needed for each fitted parameter, and separate schedule/source groups for held-out validation. Neither six candidates nor eight bootstrap jobs are a qualification claim.
operator_measurement_policy.new_model_rule: Freeze a new immutable model/runtime selection, preserve prior observations, and compare compiler candidates under the same new evaluator. Never silently change prices during a request.
operator_measurement_policy.queue_model_rule: Model Gemmini ROB admission, dependencies, finite capacity, service and resource-specific release; scalar in-order Rocket. Inspect actual interleaving and asynchronous buffer ownership. Current execute-overlap restrictions must not be interpreted as performance regressions.
operator_measurement_policy.selection_rule: Run only after complete numerical correctness and emitted-mechanism review; reuse exact matching evidence first. A whitelist is permission, not a queue of tests.
operator_measurement_policy.stop_rule: Do not request another gSIM run when matching evidence resolves the question, when the relevant schedule ranking is insensitive to the remaining uncertainty, or when the remaining budget cannot produce an identifiable update.
